title: PPC Agency Manchester: Google, Meta, TikTok Ads | 22 Signals
description: A PPC agency Manchester firms use for Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok ads measured on leads and sales, with creative made in-house and tracking set up right.
h1: PPC agency Manchester businesses use to buy leads, not clicks
intro: We plan and run paid media for established Manchester companies across Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok. We make the ad creative in-house, build the landing pages, set up conversion and call tracking, and connect results to your CRM, so every pound of spend can be traced to an enquiry or a sale.

sections.h: Clicks are easy to buy. Customers are not.
p: Plenty of Manchester businesses already spend on ads and get a monthly report full of impressions, clicks and click-through rates. What the report rarely says is how many of those clicks became paying customers, because tracking stops at the form fill or never started at all.
We fix that first. Once spend is tied to real outcomes, decisions get simple: put more behind what brings customers, cut what does not, and stop paying for traffic that was never going to buy.

A common example: a Manchester retailer sees strong return on ad spend in Google, but the figure counts orders that were later returned and customers who would have bought anyway through a brand search. Once returns and brand terms are separated out, the real picture often tells a different story about which campaigns deserve the budget.

list: Google Search and Performance Max, including Shopping feeds for online retailers.
YouTube campaigns, from short bumper ads to longer explainer formats.
Meta (Facebook and Instagram) for prospecting, retargeting and catalogue ads.
LinkedIn for B2B targeting by job title, sector and company size.
TikTok for brands whose customers live there.
Creative made in-house: static, video, motion and 3D.
Landing pages built and tested for each campaign.
Conversion tracking, call tracking and CRM connection so results show up as revenue.

sections.h: What paid media looks like for Manchester sectors
list: Fashion, beauty and e-commerce: Shopping and Performance Max with a clean product feed, Meta and TikTok creative refreshed often enough to beat fatigue, and margin-aware bidding.

Spinningfields financial and professional services: high-intent Google Search and LinkedIn, with careful copy. Google requires FCA authorisation checks for many UK financial services advertisers, and we handle that verification process with you.
Manufacturers and B2B suppliers across Greater Manchester: LinkedIn and Search aimed at buyers and engineers, with long sales cycles tracked through the CRM.
Clinics and health businesses: compliant ad copy and landing pages, given extra restrictions on health and medical advertising.
Tech and SaaS firms: trial and demo campaigns measured on qualified pipeline, not sign-ups alone.

p: All UK advertising must follow the CAP Code, enforced by the Advertising Standards Authority, which covers claims, pricing, comparisons and how influencer and social ads are labelled. Tracking must respect consent too: under PECR and UK GDPR, advertising cookies need permission, and the ICO, headquartered in Wilmslow just outside Manchester, has been clear about this. We set up Google Consent Mode and a proper consent tool so your campaigns keep measuring within the rules.
The upside of doing this properly is cleaner data. When tracking is set up correctly, the numbers in Google and Meta match far more closely with what your CRM records.

sections.h: Proof: ads joined to the rest of the work
p: For a beauty salon we rebuilt the website, ran its SEO and managed its Google Ads together. Because one team owned all three, the ads sent people to pages built to convert, the search work reduced reliance on paid clicks over time, and the reporting showed which channel brought which bookings. That joined-up approach is how we would run paid media for a Manchester business.

We work from our London head office and do not have a Manchester office or local team. Paid media runs entirely inside the ad platforms, so it suits remote delivery; where the team sits changes nothing about results. You get a weekly update and a monthly review call in UK hours, and Manchester's time zone matches ours. When a campaign launch or creative shoot needs it, your Signal Lead comes to Manchester in person.
Ad spend is paid to the platforms directly. Our fee depends on:

How much creative is needed each month, and in which formats.

Reporting depth and how often you want to meet.

That means faster creative testing and fewer excuses when results lag. Related services: SEO and GEO, video production and animation, web development and our Manchester hub.

faqs.q: What budget do we need for paid ads in Manchester?
faqs.a: It depends on your market, margins and goals. A local B2B firm may need far less than a fashion brand selling across the UK. We look at search volumes, competitor activity and the value of a customer, then recommend a starting budget with a clear test plan. Ad spend goes to the platforms; our fee is separate.

faqs.q: Should we use Google or Meta ads?
faqs.a: Google Search captures people already looking for what you sell, so it suits high-intent services. Meta and TikTok create demand among people who were not searching yet, which suits fashion, beauty and consumer brands. Many businesses use both, with tracking that shows how they work together.

faqs.q: Do you make the ad creative?
faqs.a: Yes. Our in-house teams produce static ads, short-form video, motion graphics, 3D product visuals and clearly labelled AI video variations. Having creative and media in one team means we can test new ideas weekly instead of waiting on another agency.

faqs.q: Can you advertise financial services in the UK?
faqs.a: Yes, within the rules. Google requires many UK financial services advertisers to be FCA authorised and verified before ads can run, and all ads must meet ASA and FCA standards on clarity and fairness. We work with your compliance team on copy and handle the platform verification steps with you.

faqs.q: How do we compare one PPC agency Manchester firms recommend with another?
faqs.a: Ask three things. Will they report on cost per lead or sale from your CRM, not just clicks? Who makes the creative and landing pages, and how often do they test new ones? Will the ad accounts stay in your name? An agency that answers all three clearly is usually worth a proper conversation.

faqs.q: Do we keep our ad accounts if we leave?
faqs.a: Always. Accounts are created or kept in your business's name, you have admin access, and the campaign history, audiences and conversion data stay with you. We never hold accounts hostage.

faqs.q: Will you meet us in Manchester?
faqs.a: When the project needs it, yes, for example a launch planning session or a creative shoot. Most of the work happens in the platforms, so weekly updates and monthly reviews run by video call during normal UK hours.
